scope: staged top-master admission before a distinct AirDrop endpoint

mifDifferential.finding: The same legacy-sized espDrop MIF was accepted in the earlier distance-zero admission control, while both successful and unsuccessful Apple peers used the current longer Data Path form. The longer Apple form is therefore not the demonstrated admission discriminant and was not fabricated from unrelated infrastructure state.

hardwareExperiments.name: top-master-bypass-control
hardwareExperiments.qualification: Valid control of the direct-target branch; it did not exercise staged child admission.

hardwareExperiments.name: rotating-child-topology
hardwareExperiments.qualification: Negative response evidence, but not a clean staged-admission test: the live election changed twice during the bounded session. This run motivated freezing the qualified pair.

hardwareExperiments.name: frozen-distinct-anchor-run
hardwareExperiments.qualification: Clean test of the frozen two-stage branch. The exact top master received all 14 radio-successful probe bursts but supplied no directed admission evidence, so the gate correctly never progressed to the AirDrop child.

result.confirmed: The lab can distinguish anchor and endpoint admission, select and freeze a distinct top master first, require an exact anchor reply before progressing, bypass staging when the endpoint is itself master, and remain passive until the pair is internally consistent. A clean hardware run held all 14 windows on one frozen top master with complete radio success and correctly withheld all endpoint and mDNS traffic when the master did not reply.
result.notConfirmed: The frozen top master returned no Neighbor Advertisement or matching Echo Reply. Top-master-first sequencing alone is therefore not sufficient to admit espDrop or reach the AirDrop child in this topology.
result.nextFocus: Compare AWDL membership/Data Path semantics that may make an Apple master recognize espDrop as a joined child, while keeping the longer Apple-only infrastructure fields evidence-driven. If that path remains negative, isolate the ESP32-S3 single-band/channel limitation.
